key_metric: Whether FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $5.10-$5.30 is held intact or narrowed/cut. H1 tracks ~+4% YoY at consensus ($1.58 + $1.05 = $2.63 vs $2.53), so the guide requires H2 adjusted EPS growth of +6% to +15% against $2.33 - and the cost savings funding it now face record diesel ($5.85/gal, 2026-09-04). Street (Citi, 2026-09-01) expects a trim to $5.00-$5.20. Secondary: identical sales ex-fuel vs the ~1.0% management framed, and FIFO gross margin direction.
